import numpy as np

def cashflows(perf, terms):
    perf = np.asarray(perf, dtype=float)
    npaths = perf.shape[0]
    ndates = perf.shape[1]
    cash = np.zeros((npaths, ndates), dtype=float)
    notional = float(terms["notional"])
    finalindex = int(terms["final_index"])
    autocall = terms["autocall"]
    coupon = terms["coupon"]
    downside = terms["downside"]
    upside = terms["upside"]
    alive = np.ones(npaths, dtype=bool)
    missed = np.zeros(npaths, dtype=float)
    for k in range(ndates):
        if not np.any(alive):
            break
        worst = np.min(perf[:, k, :], axis=1)
        coupondue = np.zeros(npaths, dtype=float)
        if coupon is not None:
            amounts = coupon["amounts"]
            if amounts[k] is not None:
                amount = float(amounts[k])
                barrier = float(coupon["barrier"])
                meets = worst >= barrier
                if bool(coupon["memory"]):
                    paymask = alive & meets
                    coupondue[paymask] = amount + missed[paymask]
                    missed[alive & meets] = 0.0
                    missed[alive & (~meets)] = missed[alive & (~meets)] + amount
                else:
                    coupondue[alive & meets] = amount
        called = np.zeros(npaths, dtype=bool)
        if autocall is not None and k != finalindex:
            callamounts = autocall["call_amounts"]
            if callamounts[k] is not None:
                trigger = float(autocall["trigger"])
                called = alive & (worst >= trigger)
                if np.any(called):
                    cash[called, k] = float(callamounts[k])
        if np.any(called):
            alive[called] = False
        remaining = alive.copy()
        if k == finalindex:
            if np.any(remaining):
                finalperf = perf[:, k, 0] if perf.shape[2] == 1 else np.min(perf[:, k, :], axis=1)
                level = float(downside["level"])
                gearing = float(downside["gearing"])
                payoff = np.full(npaths, notional, dtype=float)
                upmask = finalperf > 1.0
                downmask = finalperf < level
                if upside is not None:
                    leverage = float(upside["leverage"])
                    cap = upside["cap"]
                    upreturn = leverage * (finalperf - 1.0)
                    if cap is not None:
                        upreturn = np.minimum(upreturn, float(cap))
                    payoff[upmask] = notional * (1.0 + upreturn[upmask])
                else:
                    payoff[upmask] = notional * (1.0 + (finalperf[upmask] - 1.0))
                if str(downside["kind"]) == "buffer":
                    payoff[downmask] = notional * (1.0 - gearing * (level - finalperf[downmask]))
                else:
                    payoff[downmask] = notional * (1.0 - gearing * (1.0 - finalperf[downmask]))
                payoff = np.maximum(payoff, 0.10 * notional)
                if upside is not None and upside["cap"] is not None:
                    payoff = np.minimum(payoff, notional * (1.0 + float(upside["cap"])))
                cash[remaining, k] = payoff[remaining] + coupondue[remaining]
            alive[:] = False
        else:
            if np.any(remaining):
                cash[remaining, k] = cash[remaining, k] + coupondue[remaining]
    return cash
